entities.summary: Francesc Capdevila Gisbert, better known by his pen-name Max, is a Catalan artist who has worked in illustration, design, and comics. He is an important figure in Spanish comics, creating such popular characters as Gustavo and Peter Pank early in his career, and more recently Bardín. His clear line style tells humorous, angry, and sad, surrealistic stories.
